get.summary: Server / API versions and minimum client versions for negotiation.

initialized.description: false until the first admin is created via POST /api/auth/init

oneOf.description: Client is older than the server's minimum: the client must upgrade.
Client speaks a newer API major than this server: the server must upgrade.

Compat.description: Outcome of negotiating a client against this server.

modes.description: any of anonymous | logged_in | password (combinable); empty list removes the gate

password.description: required when "password" is in modes (kept if omitted on update)

kind.description: Driver kind: fs | s3 | webdav (rclone / OpenList bridge via webdav).

name.description: Top-level folder name in the virtual tree (no '/').

task_id.description: Present when the operation runs as a background task (cross-storage copy/move).

visible_mounts.description: Mount names; `[]`… or null via `clear_visible_mounts` for all.

allow.description: read | download | upload | create | edit | delete | share

enabled.description: false when the requested mode is unavailable (semantic/hybrid in M1)
